KEN.note: Ethics standards, a risk institute and an AI Act are only planned in the strategy.
Only AI skilling of public servants is stated; no AI system in government use.
No sectoral AI tool stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy launched the Kenya National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2025-2030 in March 2025, a five-year plan.
CIPIT, citing ITWeb Africa, says the government has allocated USD 1.19 billion (Ksh 152 billion) to the National AI Strategy to 2030, 50% of it for AI infrastructure.

KEN.note: AI data centres and local models are planned in the strategy with no named site or builder; Konza's data centre is not stated to have AI computing.
Nothing stated on an authentication service.

facts.fact: Kenya announced an AI skilling project to train 100,000 public servants, with a Project Implementation Board for the Regional Centre of Competence on Digital and AI Skilling for Public Service set up and programmes being finalised by July 2025.
facts.system: AI skilling project for public servants

KEN.note: A National Cybersecurity Operation Centre and AI threat systems are only proposed in the strategy.
Konza is said to house Kenya's data centre, but it is not stated to rent to others; three AI data centres are only planned.
A national data policy is only called for in the AI strategy; no drafting is stated.
Enhancing data residency requirements is only a planned strategy project.
Harmonising East African laws for cross-border transfer is only planned.
Curricula and training programmes for citizens are planned; none is stated in service.
Nothing stated that settles the study's questions.
Only a planned inclusivity framework.
Local device assembly and a semiconductor facility are only planned.
Nothing stated on who builds or runs government systems.
Konza's data centre is not stated to be for hire.
Public participation in AI policy making is only planned.
Data and ethical AI standards are only planned.
Only planned AI startup support and a toolkit; no startup law or fund stated.
Hub upgrades and AI centres are planned; Konza is not stated to have tenants.
